incidents.name: INVISTECH charges buy tax from the pair itself
incidents.notes: On buys from the INVISTECH/WBNB pair the token's _transfer charges its tax out of the pair's own balance, so a WBNB flash loan plus a pre-positioned helper could shrink the pool's INVISTECH and sell back at the distorted price.
